title: Minimum Number Of K Consecutive Bit Flips
description: Flip k consecutive bits until all elements are 1s, return minimum flips or -1 if impossible.

steps.note: Initialize flips and currentFlip tracking window state.
Flip initiated at index 0, window size k=2.
Index 1: A[1] is 1, currentFlip is 1. (1 + 1) % 2 == 0. Need flip.
Return -1 as K-consecutive flip is impossible.
